description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView adapter called DeviceAdapter for a smart home TV control application. It manages a list of devices (lights, fans, AC units), providing focus handling, visual feedback, and toggling functionality through clicks and key events, tailored for a TV interface with DPAD navigation.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter for displaying devices with focus highlights and toggle functionality.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter.Device
classes.description: Data class representing a device with id, name, type, and state.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter.DeviceVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class binding views for a device item.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a DeviceVH instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds device data to views, sets up focus visuals, click and key event handlers.

methods.name: bindIcon
methods.description: Sets icon text and description based on device type.

methods.name: applyState
methods.description: Updates background color, text, and icon color based on device ON/OFF state.
